notes: INSIDE half of the Prismatic Prism Lens: a big cyan crystal in a violet cradle with light shafts to two small lenses, a steel hatch, power coupling and five crystals that light magenta while charging and cyan-white when ready. fire: the crystals flash white. damaged: the crystal is cracked and flickers, two crystals dark; disabled: the crystal split and dull. Barrel layer prismatic_prism_lens_barrel: a long violet tube with cyan inlays, a focusing lens ring and a glass prism at the tip; fire: a white beam splits into magenta, cyan and yellow at the prism. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
